generation_capture.final_message: Thinness makes every parallel pair of morphisms equal, so arrows both ways are automatically inverse. Skeletalization then turns isomorphism into literal equality: this makes functor categories into a thin skeletal setting and makes the thin-skeleton identity map trivial. Likewise, full faithfulness reflects isomorphisms, so the induced map on skeletons—i.e. on isomorphism classes—is injective.
